architecture.hexagonal: Editor/Viewer driving adapters -> approved commands -> HOST use case -> WORK immutable design/binding projections; HOST -> approved document/asset/verified-generation abstractions <- codecs/native adapters.
architecture.dependencies: M01 selected target + document owner + M02 verified generated snapshot + M05 material availability -> M03 projected Editor/Viewer state. M04/M07 observe content commits only, not ephemeral preview changes.
architecture.ownership: Document owner remains authoritative. Editor draft, selection and isolated mock Viewer state are explicit separate lifecycle projections, never writable mirrors of other documents.
architecture.mutation: Editor content edits use declared application mutation boundary. Selection/cross-location is view-only. Viewer uses mock-only allowlist and cannot call arbitrary dispatch commands.
architecture.transaction: Load/validate/bind immutable design revision -> build temporary preview projection -> replace Viewer projection only on success. Failure retains previous verified projection with stale label. No preview process writes source state.

UI_schema.role: local project author without programming/Git prerequisite
UI_schema.defaults: Editor is safe selection/edit mode; Viewer must be explicitly entered for mock interaction. Exact persisted mode default remains proposed.
UI_schema.disabled: Cross-locate disabled when mapping unresolved/ambiguous. Dependent mock action disabled if required capability/material missing. Refresh unavailable while source binding invalid.
UI_schema.errors: Report stale revision, unsupported action, invalid preview or missing material without claiming success.
UI_schema.empty: Explain no controls/no verified preview and provide only meaningful approved actions.
UI_schema.accessibility: Visible focus, keyboard-accessible mode/actions, announced status/error, no color-only capability distinction.
